sloka: ऋषिपुत्रम् ददर्श अथो दीप्यमानम् इव अनलम् ।ततो राजा यथा योग्यम् पूजाम् चक्रे विशेषतः ॥१-११-१६॥
transliteration: ṛṣiputram dadarśa atho dīpyamānam iva analam ।tato rājā yathā yogyam pūjām cakre viśeṣataḥ ॥1-11-16॥

translations.english: Then the king (Romapada), delighted at heart out of friendship with the king (Dasaratha), offered special hospitality with respectful salutations in accordance with propriety.
